newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Elections to 4,368 out of total 4,461 Union Parishads of the country will be held from September 1 to 30 this year, an official announcement said.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked lawmakers belonging to her party to guard against terrorism and remain ever vigilant so that no terrorist could enter (ruling) Awami League.
Huge mobilisation of Indian troops along the 180-km border of Kurigram and Lalmonirhat districts during the last few days has caused apprehensions among the villagers.
Participants at a discussion yesterday said the capital market needed reforms on all fronts and involvement of more institutional investors will help bring about qualitative change in the bourse.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) will stage demonstration across the country on March 3 marking the launch of fresh agitation against the government.
The government came under strong pressure from the donors to adjust the prices of petroleum, gas and fertilizer to unload the extra burden on the budget.
Food and Agriculture Minister Matia Chowdhury said the government had set about the task of giving agriculture a big push through an intensified programme of research, extension and farmers' linkage.

A two-judge bench of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court on Wednesday declared "illegal" the assessment of import duty and sales tax of reconditioned cars on the basis of value based on clean report of finding (CRF) and invoice given by importers.
